notableFindings: Back Cove 33 and 34 documented as a designation/evolution sequence; both retained as marketed identities.
Back Cove 39 corrected to 39O, with triple outboards standard and twin 600 hp outboard option.
Back Cove 33/39O/41 flybridge and aft-cabin legacy flags corrected to No.
Duffy models retained as hull-family records with custom/semi-custom finish variation; not overstated as standardized production cruisers.
Fortier duplicate FORT-33-DE retained Initial and flagged for later ID consolidation; it was not guessed to be a Fortier 30.
Hunt records normalized as Surfhunter 29 and Surfhunter 36 Coupe.
Sabre records normalized as 34 Express and 38 Salon Express.
BHM, Atlantic Boat and Sisu retained Initial where model-wide standard specifications remain weak.
Atlantic 37 normalized as 37 Double Cabin/Prairie-derived trawler rather than lobster-hull cruiser.
True North 34 preserved as original diesel generation; later 34 Outboard Express flagged as a distinct future model record.
